A goal setting app that won't flatter you

Every other goal app is a cheerleader. Fruition is a coach that tells you the truth. It pushes back when a timeline isn't realistic and offers one that is, says plainly when it can't verify your progress instead of faking a grade, and won't help you rush a goal that could hurt you.

It's built for the long middle of a goal, where most plans quietly die: one clear action a day, evidence of what you actually did, and a plan that changes only when you agree to it. Fruition counts the days you show up, not a streak you can break.

Plant

Start with one line

Type your goal in your own words, like learning to paint with watercolors or reading 20 books this year. The coach asks up to four short questions to understand where you're starting from. Type your answers, or dictate them in English with on-device speech recognition.

Honest read

Get the truth about your timeline

Fruition gives you a verdict, from achievable to not in this time-box, with a confidence meter and a plain explanation of what your timeline can really hold. If it's too tight, the coach suggests a realistic one, or locks in the first few weeks and checks again once there's real evidence.

Living plan

One clear action a day

Your goal becomes a path of milestones, each with a checkpoint and a target week, and a daily action you can mark done. A short note from your coach explains what matters right now, and you can tap What does this mean? for more.

Evidence

Show your work, get a real read

Add a photo, a number, a reflection or a measurement, or import a number from Apple Health. The coach tells you whether you're ahead, on track or behind, and if it can't verify something, it says so. When it suggests changing the plan, nothing changes until you choose it.

Harvest

Bring it to harvest

When the last milestone is done, Fruition writes a short harvest reflection drawn from your real record, with a card you can share. Finished goals move to your Orchard, so you can see everything you've grown.

A coach that keeps up with you

Check-ins before you ask

Your coach reaches out when you fall behind. With Fruition+ it also reaches out when you're ahead of plan, and sends a weekly letter about how it's going.

See the whole path

Every milestone shows where it stands, from the first weeks to the finish line, so you always know what's next and what's done.

Honest by design

It pushes back

If a timeline isn't realistic, Fruition says so and offers one that is. It won't help you rush a goal that could hurt you.

Check in from your Lock Screen

Answer the daily reminder with Did it, Not yet or Log it without opening the app, and your coach replies in a line.

Your coach, your way

Choose a gentle, balanced or direct tone, how often your coach reaches out, and whether that's morning, midday or evening. You can even give your coach a name.

No account, no sign-up

Your goals sync through your own iCloud, and your evidence photos stay on your device unless you send one for a read.

Made for iPhone and iPad

Fruition is built natively for iPhone and iPad, with a sidebar layout on iPad. Your goals and your Orchard sync through your own iCloud, so you can check in on either.

Fruition FAQ

Is Fruition free?

Yes, for your first goal. It's free from start to finish: the questions, the honest read, your plan, daily notes, evidence reads and harvest. Fruition+ adds proactive check-ins, a weekly letter, deeper evidence reads and a new goal whenever you're ready, for $5.99 a month or $49.99 a year in the US. There are no ads.

How is Fruition different from other goal apps?

Most goal apps cheer you on whatever you set. Fruition tells you whether your timeline is realistic, explains why, and adjusts the plan as your real evidence comes in. It counts the days you show up instead of streaks, and it never fakes a grade.

Is Fruition a habit tracker?

It tracks the daily actions that move a goal forward, and you can check them off from your Lock Screen. But each habit serves a goal with milestones and an end point, and a coach reads your progress instead of just counting check-marks.

What kinds of goals can I set?

Anything you can work toward step by step: learning a skill, finishing a project, reading more, building a routine, preparing for an exam. Fruition won't help you rush a goal that could hurt you, and it will suggest a better way to frame it.

Does Fruition use AI?

Yes. Your coach's reads, plans and replies are written by Anthropic's Claude models through our own server, which doesn't store what you send. Fruition sends what the coach needs to answer: your goal, your answers, your check-ins and, when you ask for a read, the evidence you submit. Dictation happens on your device.

Do I need an account?

No. There's no sign-up and no login. Your goals and your Orchard sync between your iPhone and iPad through your own iCloud.

Is Fruition on Android?

Not at the moment. Fruition is made for iPhone and iPad and requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later.

What languages does Fruition support?

English, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Simplified Chinese, and your coach writes to you in the app's language. Voice dictation is available in English.

How do I get support?

Answers about purchases, restoring Fruition+ and syncing are on the Fruition support page at postmarkdigital.com/fruition/support/, or email hello@postmarkdigital.com.
